snippet.title: REGRET | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
REGRET is a four-player co-op elimination game where participants are forced to survive a series of psychologically intense trials inside a prison ruled by a totalitarian regime.

Each round introduces a new challenge that tests players’ reaction speed, attention, memory, or trust in one another. After every round, one player is eliminated. The trials continue until only a single survivor remains.

The game focuses on tension, social interaction, and unexpected decisions, enhanced by an atmospheric visual style and professional sound design.
